item.title: Bond market to stay cautious ahead of RBI policy: Equirus
item.description: The bond market is expected to remain cautious due to persistent inflationary pressures and anticipated rate hikes. Analysts predict a 25 basis points hike in the RBI's upcoming monetary policy review. Market yields are likely to be influenced by geopolitical tensions and global bond movements. Foreign portfolio investor inflows and stable currency conditions may provide some support for bond yields.

item.title: Gold pares gains as Fed hike risks linger, eyes first weekly rise in three weeks
item.description: Gold prices saw a notable uptick as investors seized the opportunity for bargain purchases, despite a robust US dollar and escalating yields causing some hesitance. After reaching a 15-month low recently, spot gold has recorded a potential weekly increase of nearly 3%. Analysts caution, however, that ongoing rate increases from the Fed could stifle any further upward movement.
